finalText:
I worked the P-DOC and P-MON backorders and notified 14 customers. The plan needed one change: PO-91 (4 P-DOC) was recorded as received while I was allocating, so my P-DOC results differ from the plan's.

**What I confirmed first:** the tool date is 2026-07-25 and PO-88 and PO-89 were received, giving 7 P-DOC and 4 P-MON. PU-9 (gold ranks with platinum) expired on 06-30, so I didn't apply it. PU-12 is in force, so orders placed on or before 07-11 go first. The inbox is empty.

**Allocated from PO-88/PO-89 (7 P-DOC, 4 P-MON):**
- O-5201 L1.
- O-5202 L1 and L2.
- O-5203 L1.
- O-5204 L1.
- O-5207 L1 and L2 (ship-complete, both lines filled together).
- O-5210 L1.

**Allocated from PO-91's 4 P-DOC, which arrived mid-run:** The 4 units were on the shelf and the handbook sends received stock to backorders in priority order, so I allocated them to O-5209, O-5211 and O-5215. O-5213 (needs 2, only 1 left) waits. This goes slightly beyond the "PO-88/PO-89" wording. If you wanted PO-91 left alone, those three allocations are the ones to undo.

**Left alone:**
- O-5205 (C-525) is on risk hold. It got no allocation, no promise date and no notice.
- O-5206 is ship-complete and its HUB line has no stock, so the whole order waits.

**Promise dates set for lines still waiting:**

| Line | Date | Source |
|---|---|---|
| O-5208 L1 | 08-05 | PO-93 |
| O-5212 L1 | 08-05 | PO-93 |
| O-5214 L1 | 08-19 | PO-97 |
| O-5213 L1 | 08-14 | PO-95 |
| O-5206 L1 and L2 | 08-14 | latest of its lines (DOC 08-14 from PO-95, HUB 08-06 from PO-90) |

The plan had O-5206 at 08-06 and several DOC lines at 08-03. Both depended on PO-91 still being in transit, so I changed them.

**Notices:** I sent one per customer to C-521 through C-524 and C-526 through C-535, 14 in all. I didn't contact C-525.

P-DOC and P-MON stock are both now 0.
